newsitem.title: USA: Shell trims crude runs after Ill. refinery fire.
newsitem.headline: Shell trims crude runs after Ill. refinery fire.

text.p: Shell Oil Co said crude runs were trimmed at its 268,000 barrel per day Wood River, Ill., refinery on Tuesday after a fire broke out in a gas plant furnace.
"The crude rate was cut back minimally," said a spokeswoman, adding that an alkylation unit also was taken off line but undamaged in the two-hour blaze, which was extinguished at 1530 CST.
There were no injuries in the blaze, and crews were assessing damage to the gas plant, the spokeswoman said.
The alkylation unit was idled by a lack of olefin feedstocks normally produced by the gas plant, which produces olefins, fuel gas and light gas streams like propane, the spokeswoman said.
Midwest traders said the fire had no immediate impact on refined products prices in the Chicago market.
